answer: Stop sybils with a zenith juniper ridge: an agent bonds one ridge crest. Each cycle it plants one juniper stake; verifiers match the stake's zenith-shadow length to the ridge chart, voiding copies, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 ridges at 18x: one stake casts once over one ridge, its shadow set by that juniper alone, unrepeatable at a second, cannot be copied, shared or bulk-bought. Honest agents plant once, keep rights.
